excerpt: Schaffer's contrastive grounding is formulated with facts F rather than F* grounding facts G rather than G*, but B's truth rather than falsity grounds itself, and E's and F's truth contrasts ground each other.
overview: The final formal check prevents a retreat to contrastive grounding from restoring strict orderhood. Even when grounding is modeled as a quaternary relation between differences, the same reflexive and symmetric constructions violate differential irreflexivity and differential asymmetry.
title: Differential Grounding Failure
